# 可能形・ことができる — the two ways to say "can"

## ことができる { #ことができる }

Can do; formal, nominalized expression of ability or permission

*N4-upper · periphrastic-construction · ability-possibility*

## 可能形 (potential) { #可能形 }

Can do something; expresses ability or situational possibility

*N4-upper · verb-inflection-potential · ability-possibility*

## 可能形＋が (を→が shift) { #可能形＋が }

Potential form commonly marks the object with が instead of を

*N4-upper · verb-inflection-potential · ability-possibility*
